title: ECLiPSE: A Versatile Classification Technique for Structural and Morphological Analysis of Super-Resolution Microscopy Data
authors: Hugelier S; Kim H; Gyparaki MT; Bond C; Tang Q; Santiago-Ruiz AN; Porta S; Lakadamyali M
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习对超分辨显微图像中的细胞结构进行分类，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: We introduce a new automated machine learning analysis pipeline to precisely classify cellular structures captured through single molecule localization microscopy, which we call ECLiPSE (Enhanced Classification of Localized Pointclouds by Shape Extraction). ECLiPSE leverages 67 comprehensive shape descriptors encompassing geometric, boundary, skeleton and other properties, the majority of which are directly extracted from the localizations to accurately characterize individual structures. We validate ECLiPSE through unsupervised and supervised classification on a dataset featuring five distinct cellular structures, achieving exceptionally high classification accuracies nearing 100%. Moreover, we demonstrate the versatility of our approach by applying it to two novel biological applications: quantifying the clearance of tau protein aggregates, a critical marker for neurodegenerative diseases, and differentiating between two distinct morphological features (morphotypes) of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 proteinopathy, potentially associated to different TDP-43 strains, each exhibiting unique seeding and spreading properties. We anticipate that this versatile approach will significantly enhance the way we study cellular structures across various biological contexts, elucidating their roles in disease development and progression.
abstract_zh: 我们介绍一种新的自动化机器学习分析流程，用于精确分类通过单分子定位显微镜捕获的细胞结构，我们称之为ECLiPSE（通过形状提取增强的定位点云分类）。ECLipSE利用67个全面的形状描述符，涵盖几何、边界、骨架及其他属性，其中大部分直接从定位中提取，以精确表征单个结构。我们通过在一个包含五种不同细胞结构的数据集上进行无监督和监督分类来验证ECLiPSE，实现了接近100%的极高分类准确率。此外，我们通过将其应用于两个新颖的生物学应用来展示我们方法的多样性：量化tau蛋白聚集体的清除，这是神经退行性疾病的关键标志物，以及区分TAR DNA结合蛋白43蛋白病的两种不同形态特征（形态型），这可能与具有独特播种和传播特性的不同TDP-43菌株相关。我们预期这种多功能方法将显著增强我们在各种生物学背景下研究细胞结构的方式，阐明它们在疾病发展和进展中的作用。
